analysis.overall: You spent 85% of your day in range with a rock-solid overnight baseline, though stacked correction doses in the afternoon led to a prolonged low.

events.title: Stacked correction low
events.description: Repeated 0.3u correction doses for an earlier high caught up all at once, pulling glucose down to 54 mg/dL for about 45 minutes.

events.title: Dinner stabilization
events.description: A 2.1u meal dose successfully checked a rebound rise to 198 mg/dL, gently guiding levels back down into target.

events.title: Smooth overnight baseline
events.description: Levels stayed exceptionally flat between 80 and 110 mg/dL all night long.

events.title: Breakfast peak
events.description: Glucose climbed quickly from 82 mg/dL up to 205 mg/dL around breakfast before the 3.6u dose brought it back under control.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Be cautious with back-to-back correction boluses during highs, as overlapping doses can trigger delayed lows hours later.
